name: Encrypted Letter
summary: Among the Syndicate documents, one of the letters on a table is encrypted and inscrutable. Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore is the one to show it to.

sections.title: A Letter No One Can Read
sections.body: Among the Syndicate documents lies a table of letters, and one of them is encrypted and inscrutable. Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore is the one to show it to.

sections.title: What Dibbs Makes of It
sections.body: Dibbs takes a closer look and admits never having seen this form of encryption before. Dibbs confesses that such learning is by no means complete.

faq.q: Where does the letter come from?
faq.answer: It is one of the letters on a table among the Syndicate documents, and this one is encrypted.

faq.q: Who is the letter taken to?
